## detectGroupableFields

Detect groupable fields from an array of items
Returns fields that are simple strings (not objects, arrays, dates)
and have a reasonable number of unique values (2-20)

```ts
detectGroupableFields(items: T[], exclude: string[] = ['id', 'teamId', 'owner', 'createdBy', 'updatedBy', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt']): { field: string; uniqueValues: number }[]
```

_Source: `packages/crouton-core/app/composables/useKanban.ts`_

## useRemoteCollectionRefresh

Re-run `refresh` when a remote client changed `collection` (the
`crouton:remoteChange` hook, fired by crouton-collab). Call it before any
`await` so the Nuxt context + effect scope are still active; the hook is
removed when that scope is disposed.

```ts
useRemoteCollectionRefresh(collection: string, refresh: () => unknown)
```

_Source: `packages/crouton-core/app/composables/useRemoteCollectionRefresh.ts`_
